rules.statement: A tenant can only validly pledge his lease without the consent of the landlord where he has the right of ceding or assigning both his rights and obligations without the consent of the landlord.
rules.supporting_quote: Wille, p. 178 he lays down that a tenant can only validly pledge his lease without the consent of the landlord where he has the right of ceding or assigning both his rights and obligations without the consent of the landlord.
